name: flixty
description: Open-source social media creator studio — publish, schedule and analyze posts across X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, with AI-assisted content.

X_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. X / Twitter app client ID — https://developer.twitter.com/en/portal

X_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. X / Twitter app client secret.

LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. LinkedIn app client ID — https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps

LINKEDIN_ENABLE_ORGANIZATIONS.description: Set to true only after LinkedIn approves organization/page posting scopes.

FB_APP_ID.description: Optional. Facebook app ID (also used for Instagram) — https://developers.facebook.com/apps

TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY.description: Optional. TikTok client key — https://developers.tiktok.com/ (enable Content Posting API)

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Google OAuth client ID for YouTube and Google Sign-In — https://console.cloud.google.com/ (enable YouTube Data API v3)

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Server-wide fallback key for AI Assist — https://console.anthropic.com/. Users can also add their own key in AI Settings.

VIDEO_API_TIMEOUT_MS.description: How long (ms) a text-to-video request may run before it's abandoned. Default 12 minutes.
